name: Jaipur
summary: Rajasthan's Pink City with forts, palaces, bazaars and handicrafts.
season_note: October to March is pleasant; summer is very hot.
avoid_note: April to June is dangerously hot at midday.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre; category as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Jaipur (via Delhi/Kolkata) (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India; often via Kolkata)
reach.note: Usually a connecting flight; or fly to Delhi and drive 5 hours.

reach.how: Delhi to Jaipur by Shatabdi/Vande Bharat or AC bus

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.what: A hilltop fort-palace with mirror-work halls.
attractions.tip: Go early to avoid queues; avoid elephant rides.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.what: Royal residence with museums and courtyards.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.tip: Best photographed from a cafe across the street in the morning.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.what: A UNESCO astronomical observatory with giant instruments.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort sunset
attractions.what: A hill fort with city views at sunset.
attractions.tip: Take a cab; the road is steep.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.what: Jewellery, fabrics, mojari shoes and blockprints.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal (viewpoint)
attractions.what: A palace in the middle of the lake, viewed from the road.

rules: Dress modestly at forts and temples.
Shopping: bargain; beware of fake gems.
Do not ride elephants; animal welfare concerns.
